title: With `-flambda2-match-in-match`, a region begun in a loop is never ended
summary: At `-O2` and `-O3` with `-flambda2-match-in-match`, the region of `g`, inlined into the loop, is begun in every turn and never ended, so the local stack grows until the program stops with `Local allocation stack overflow - out of memory`. With a `try` or an `exclave_` in the region, the lost end also gives wrong values.

actual.text: `Fatal error: Local allocation stack overflow - out of memory`.

cause: After the handler is specialised, the region is a parameter of a lifted continuation used only by `End_region`; the flow analysis (`middle_end/flambda2/simplify/flow/flow_acc.ml`) does not count that use, and `simplify_let_expr.ml` deletes an `End_region` whose region is not required.

fix.text: Makes a region parameter given to `End_region` required whenever a region passed for it is. Builds; `test.ml` then prints the expected result; testsuite unchanged.
